crossRefs.note: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…
You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
“I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I…
You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I…
He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

translations.web: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
translations.bsb: O God of my praise, be not silent.
translations.kjv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
translations.asv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
